explanation.surface: An emphatic denial that something has been destroyed.

explanation.definitionFit: Someone with no means has no money at all; someone financially wiped out is ruined, and both describe insolvency.

explanation.surface: Edward alone was the one who thought things through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used his head' seems to mean thought cleverly, but here it is literal: struck with the head, as a goat does.
explanation.definitionFit: To butt is to strike with the head, as a ram or goat does, so it means literally used the head.

clue.text: None start a quarrel-that would be small-minded

parts.note: a quarrel is the bolt fired from a crossbow, a kind of arrow

explanation.walkthrough: 'quarrel' looks like a row, but it is the medieval crossbow bolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow mind is a limited, intolerant one, the opposite of broad-minded.

clue.text: Drill in the end made by farm machinery

parts.note: the rear is the back end
PE, physical education, is school drill or exercise

explanation.surface: A farmer finishes up drilling with a harvesting machine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drill' suggests a seed drill on the farm, but it is PE, physical exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A harvesting machine that cuts grain is a piece of farm machinery.

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical term for quietly
householders are the residents of a place

explanation.surface: Who heads the residents' association on a peaceful street?
explanation.definitionFit: Heads of states, companies and societies are often given that title, so they are leaders.

indicators.note: only some of the letters of controversy are used, a run inside it

explanation.definitionFit: Wanderers or travellers; the term is an old one for roaming folk such as gypsies.

to shy is to throw, and so is to cast

explanation.surface: Someone excessively timid is not very clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'far from bright' looks like a dig at intelligence; it describes a cloudy sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A sky covered with cloud is dull and gloomy, far from sunny.

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London
static means not moving, still

explanation.surface: A motionless city is enchanting to behold.
explanation.walkthrough: EC (East Central) is the London postal district covering the City, its financial centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a rapture or trance of delight, the adjective here borders on enraptured, an entranced state.

clue.text: A serving man sent round about faulty gear

faulty gear is broken, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A waiter is sent back because of broken equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faulty' turns GEAR into RGEA, which 'round about' puts inside SENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-commissioned soldier is a serving man, a member of the armed forces.

clue.text: Warn of a number following earthquake

indicators.note: the number comes after the shaken letters
the second half of earthquake shakes the letters of its first half

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: Give notice of many casualties after a tremor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quake' shakes EARTH into THREA; TEN goes after it.
explanation.definitionFit: To threaten is to give a menacing warning of something to come.

parts.note: less means without, lacking, as in 'penniless'
O, the round figure zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: Is the landlord without any assets, correct?
explanation.definitionFit: A landlord who lets out a property to a tenant is that property's owner and leaser.

indicators.note: the letters of coteries can be formed into a new word

explanation.surface: Exclusive cliques may arise in secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Understood by only a few initiates, so recondite and obscure.

parts.note: a flying machine from fantasy: the vehicle of witches in fairy tales

explanation.surface: An economic downturn leads to genuine misery.
explanation.definitionFit: An economic slump is a depression, and so is a state of deep gloom or low mood.

clue.text: Make notes about animal hospital harshly critical

a cat is an animal
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Write up a report on the vet's surgery that is scornful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make notes' suggests writing; it is singing musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: A withering review is severely and harshly critical.

parts.note: the exclamation of refusal read literally: a state of doing nothing

explanation.surface: A blunt refusal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nothing doing!' is a refusal, but read literally it describes idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Idleness, the absence of activity, is literally nothing being done.

clue.text: Awfully evil leer that disturbs everyone

indicators.note: an awful leer is distorted, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dreadfully wicked leer upsets all who see it.
explanation.definitionFit: The early bugle call in a military camp rouses all the sleeping soldiers.

clue.text: Many not of nice disposition can appear sweet

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so these letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: Many unpleasant people can seem charming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' suggests temperament; it rearranges NOT OF NICE into ONFECTION.
explanation.definitionFit: A confection is a sweet treat such as candy or an elaborate dessert.

clue.text: Put an end to the call for a block

definitions.text: Put an end to the call

explanation.surface: Terminate the telephone conversation because of a mental obstacle.
explanation.definitionFit: To end a phone call is to replace the receiver; a psychological block or neurosis is also called this.

clue.text: The thief who gets coppers most angry

irate means extremely angry, furious

explanation.surface: Which criminal makes the police furious?
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' looks like police, but here they are copper coins, pennies, abbreviated P.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirate is a robber on the high seas, or anyone who steals others' work.

indicators.note: the letters needed sit inside the word progressive

explanation.surface: A dreadful woman in a forward-moving position.
explanation.definitionFit: A female ogre is a monstrous giantess, and the word is used of a frightening woman.

indicators.note: the word for diplomacy is said aloud

parts.note: tact is diplomacy, sensitivity in dealing with people

explanation.surface: A diplomat kept shifting position: that is sound diplomacy!
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective praising the diplomacy; it signals that TACT is heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailing boats zigzag into the wind by repeatedly changing direction, which is what sailors call this.

parts.note: as means like, in the manner of
saying is speaking

explanation.surface: It may resemble speech, but it is an examination.
explanation.definitionFit: To assay a metal is to test its purity, so assaying is testing.

parts.note: complete the quotation from Coriolanus, where Valeria is called 'chaste as the' hanging frozen drip 'that's curdied by the frost'

explanation.walkthrough: In Coriolanus, Act 5, Valeria is 'chaste as the icicle that's curdied by the frost from purest snow'.
explanation.definitionFit: The simile in the play compares chaste purity to frozen water hanging from a roof.

explanation.walkthrough: 'underworld' suggests organised crime; it is Dis, the classical realm of the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: Loss of reputation or honour is shame, the state of being in ill-repute.

clue.text: The male will take a look

explanation.surface: The man will have a glance.
explanation.definitionFit: A male goose is so called, and in slang taking a quick glance is 'taking a gander'.

explanation.surface: Sweaters for the bosses.
